Definition: Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ajalon or Aijalon = "field of deer"; 1) Levitical city in Dan, 14 miles or 25 km NW of Jerusalem, later ruled by the Amorites, then the Benjamites of Judah, then by the Philistines; 2) a city of Zebulun, site unknown
